gates.title: Package completeness and schema validity
notes: English is required for the public title, narrative, summary, booklet, drawing labels and legends; the language of raster images needs human review.

gates.title: Path ownership - only your own submission directory
notes: In a pull request, CI also checks that nothing outside this directory changed (scripts/check_pr_paths.py).

gates.title: Example and indicative data not presented as fact
Declared metrics reconcile with submitted geometry (2% tolerance)
HTML artefacts make no network calls
All eight agent tasks and twelve mandatory requirements answered
Every quantitative claim carries an evidence tag
Site boundaries respected
notes: Content review by the organiser completes this gate (prohibited items B1-B5).
DEM flood sensitivity is a screening layer, not a surveyed design-flood boundary or a blanket no-build zone.

gates.title: Required figures present and current; every render declared
notes: media/ images have no control_image: they are not tied to a view of the geometry

gates.title: Design evidence and presentation packaging (quality not assessed automatically)
notes: Checks evidence references (paths, metric keys and proposal headings), disclosed gap plans and presentation packaging/page order only; not readability, design adequacy or finished-image quality. Settlement hierarchy, system locations and scales, transport, resource infrastructure and phasing require independent design content review.
